title: Wrap the searchBox input in a BEM div
body:
I'm currently trying to replicate our magento styling into its own theme. Here is the current searchBox on Magento.

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/283419/10729399/312de402-7be9-11e5-91ee-149faa05d6b6.png)

I wanted to add the small magnifying glass using `:after` pseudo-element, but it is not available on `input` elements.

I suggest we always wrap the `searchBox` inside its own `<div class="ais-search-box">`, so styling is made easier (and is more consistent with our other widgets).

WDYT?

comments.body: You mean when the searchBox is generated by us we should wrap it?

I mean, with this html: ``` html
``` And this js: ``` javascript search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.searchBox({ container: '#search', placeholder: 'Search for products' }) ); ``` or this one: ``` javascript search.addWidget( instantsearch.widgets.searchBox({ container: '#search-parent', placeholder: 'Search for products' }) ); ``` The following markup should be generated: ``` html
``` (Currently the `
` is missing, and that is what I want to add)

Careful, we decided to have a mode where we would not wrap the searchBox to specifically target a bug @redox was facing:
- https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/113
- https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/25

After discussing with @redox and @vvo we came to the conclusion that we should wrap the widget in its own div by default, but also create an option (`addDivWrapper: false`?) to disable this behavior if needed.

`wrapInput:true|false`?

I find it hard to reason "add: false" :)
